summary.intent: Write a design spec for three related memory-loop features: keyword scoring, threshold presets, and a memory edit wizard.
summary.outcome: Spec written and committed to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-03-memory-loop-edit-keywords-threshold-design.md, including a self-review pass that caught and fixed one ambiguity.

repo: Keyword overlap scoring uses a 3x multiplier: keywordOverlap * 21 in the memory scoring code.
Threshold presets are described in a table and wired into the generator integration section of the spec.
The edit function signature is defined to match the wizard flow.

code.finding: Spec covers three features: keyword scoring (3x multiplier), threshold presets (table + generator integration), and edit wizard (self-contained). All in one spec because they touch overlapping scoring code.

workflow: Self-review checklist used: placeholder scan, internal consistency, scope check, ambiguity check.
Spec is written and committed before implementation planning begins; user reviews spec first.

friction: Self-review caught a missing edge case: what happens to origin field (generated vs manual) when a user edits a generated memory's title — had to add a fix before finishing.
open_items: User needs to review the spec and approve before implementation plan is written.
